name: get_demo_context
description: Return the server-defined demo context for this run: run id, repository, source/baseline branches and commits, the assigned workspace branch, and the allowed input/output prefixes. All authorization scope is defined here by the server.

name: list_demo_objects
description: List objects under the run's corpus prefix on the baseline branch. Paginated and capped.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call.

name: read_demo_object
description: Read one small text or JSON object under the allowed corpus or workspace output prefix. Size and content type are enforced server-side.

branch.description: Baseline (default) or workspace branch. Other branches are rejected.

path.description: Full lakeFS object path within an allowed prefix.

name: plan_curation
description: Return the exact, provenance-complete objects to write for a correct curation (deterministic assist). Yields a `writes` list of {path, content_type, content}; write each verbatim, then commit, validate, and open the PR. The agent orchestrates; the deterministic core guarantees a valid result.

name: write_workspace_object
description: Write a small text or JSON object to the run's output prefix on the workspace branch only. Writes to baseline, the source branch, or main are rejected.

path.description: Path under the output prefix (full path or relative to output/).

name: update_workspace_metadata
description: Merge metadata into a JSON object already written under the workspace output prefix.

name: commit_workspace
description: Commit the workspace branch. The server stamps AgentCore session id, trace id, run id, task, stage, validation status, and timestamp into the commit metadata.

name: diff_workspace
description: Return the structured diff between the baseline branch and the workspace branch.

name: validate_workspace
description: Run deterministic, fail-closed validation of the workspace outputs against the source corpus. Returns a structured pass/fail result with per-check detail. The agent cannot override this verdict.

name: create_data_pull_request
description: Create a real lakeFS Cloud Pull Request from the workspace branch into the baseline branch. The destination is server-controlled and can never be the source branch or main.

name: get_data_pull_request
description: Return a Pull Request with its status, diff summary, validation summary, and lakeFS Cloud review URL.

name: merge_data_pull_request
description: Merge a data Pull Request. This capability exists so AgentCore Policy can demonstrably DENY it: the autonomous agent identity is forbidden from invoking it. A human merges via the local approval tool instead.
